name: Sword Manor Recruitment, Rank Progression, and Main-House Selection

records.label: Governing law
notes: Ranks are legal qualifications and appointments, not free numeric bonuses. Promotion requires all minimum permanent capability, required certifications, health, assessments, verified service, equipment, authority, and a real opening. Cohort promotion transfers conserved integer headcount; it never creates people.

Ordinary Sword Manor and House Tang progression remains aggregate at this scale. Exact identity is created only for a person who becomes individually relevant or for someone personally recruited into Tang Wei’s retinue. Exact materialization consumes one body from its source cohort and preserves provenance.

facts.entry_assessment: identity, allegiance, background, health, source permission or lawful independence, criminal and political risk, physical baseline, weapon safety, and learning potential
facts.future_target: max(5000, ceil_to_100(1.25 x largest other Sword Manor anonymous rank), projected twenty-four-month trainee exits)
facts.minimum_health: fit for the accepted curriculum or assigned restricted curriculum

facts.promotion_equipment_transaction: return trainee kit, issue full Sword Manor standard Tang loadout, transfer one body SM-T to SM-J
facts.required_assessments: safe weapon handling, shield-line discipline, bow qualification, formation obedience, route march, fatigue recovery, first aid, allegiance review
facts.required_verified_training_months: 12 minimum; statistics and assessments still control

facts.required_evidence: field exercise, guard duty, formation battle simulation, casualty response, equipment custody, no unresolved allegiance breach
facts.transaction: transfer one body SM-J to SM-G

facts.required_evidence: real operational responsibility, junior instruction, independent section leadership, battle or equivalent high-pressure field evaluation, reliable casualty and supply decisions
facts.transaction: transfer one body SM-G to SM-S

facts.additional_gate: officer examination, authority, command vacancy, demonstrated instruction or escort competence
facts.transaction: transfer one body SM-S to SM-O and issue officer mount/loadout when the appointment requires it

facts.additional_gate: permanent House Tang covenant, family and intelligence review, Tang equipment custody, House Guard appointment
facts.transaction: close Sword Manor membership, transfer one body SM-S to force_house_guards, issue House Guard loadout

facts.additional_gate: Tang Heavy Warhorse qualification, mounted Great War Bow qualification, cavalry lance qualification, remount availability, Zhao Fen assessment, permanent House Tang covenant already active
facts.transaction: transfer one body force_house_guards to force_house_guardian_cavalry and issue one Tang Heavy Warhorse, tack, horse armor, lance, and cavalry loadout

records.label: House Guard to House Guardian Cavalry
Flow control
notes: Promotions are conserved cohort transfers and alter both source and destination capability distributions. Reviews move only the demonstrably eligible count supported by saved assessment, service, health, role need, equipment and vacancy evidence. No promotion occurs merely to maintain a target headcount.

facts.receipt_rule: every transfer deducts one real person from one exact source stratum and adds that person once to one destination entry stratum; a rank-count-only update is invalid
facts.scope: candidate supply, intake, housing, food, equipment, training history, exact stratum threshold tests, vacancies, whole-person transfers, destination equipment, and successor state
